text:
michelle_ae: Hey @channel — heads up: NorthLake Bank is blocking POC access until we provide SOC2 excerpts + signed pen-test SOW from their assessor. They want network access and ephemeral creds. Can we outline timelines and any pricing impact if they insist on an on-site or third-party pen-test?

sam_sec: We can share SOC2 excerpts (control mappings, infra controls, and a summary). I uploaded a redacted bundle to the evidence drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/sales/northlake/poc-evidence

sam_sec: Pen-test SOWs — we ship two templates: (1) customer-authorized scan for staging, (2) third-party vendor SOW for tests against our staging or dedicated pools. For vendor SOWs we require explicit IP ranges, test windows, and an NDA if raw vuln reports will be exchanged.

dana_compliance: Note: full SOC2 reports require a dataroom and NDA. For POCs we provide a limited excerpt focused on infra, access controls, and KMS separation. I can highlight the exact controls they asked about (KMS key separation and access logging).

raj_soleng: Pricing callouts: short-lived isolated dedicated pool (48–72h burst) is quoted as a day-rate; rough internal guide $2–3k/day plus ops support. If they want a reserved short-term pool (30–90d) we can provide a discounted committed rate. Also add a one-off infra ops fee if they need our engineers on-call during testing (~$3–5k depending on scope).

amy_prod: For Private/VPC we need network details + certs. Standard provisioning is ~3 business days after we receive all network artifacts. On-prem pen-tests require a separate SOW and on-site support option — plan extra lead time.

michelle_ae: @dana_compliance does KMS separation show in the excerpts? And what's the turnaround to sign the standard vendor SOW?

dana_compliance: KMS separation is in control A.3 in the excerpt — I will pull the exact snippet. Standard vendor SOW can be signed in 1–3 business days if legal and CISO give a quick pass. If customer adds indemnity or liability changes, that will add review time.

legal_ops: If they send their SOW, we'll redline. Typical turnaround is 1–5 business days depending on complexity. We will not accept expanded indemnity or insurance demands without risk review.

deploy-bot: Document uploaded: /evidence/northlake/poc/pen-test-templates/ (michelle_ae)

raj_soleng: AE checklist to send to customer: (1) proposed test dates; (2) IP ranges and target URLs; (3) whether they need KMS logs or actual keys; (4) persistent vs ephemeral creds; (5) whether they want results uploaded to our dataroom or delivered directly.

michelle_ae: They asked for a countersigned pen-test acceptance by Friday EOW. Is that feasible if they send SOW today?

sam_sec: EOW is possible if the SOW is standard and legal is available. If they require custom terms or want raw reports uploaded to our dataroom, expect more time.

dana_compliance: Also clarify report handling: if they want raw vuln data in our dataroom, legal will require redaction rules and an NDA that covers how we share vendor findings.

michelle_ae: (follow-up) They just uploaded their draft SOW and proposed window Mon–Tue next week. Link: https://files.redwood.internal/tmp/northlake-sow-draft.pdf

legal_ops: I'll do an initial review today. If clauses look standard I'll countersign. If there are unusual clauses, I'll flag for risk.

sam_sec: Note on creds: we provide ephemeral creds with a 7-day TTL and presigned upload links for their scanner. Persistent access requires a scoped service account and an asset registration ticket.

raj_soleng: Updated draft numbers for AE: 48–72h dedicated burst — $2.5k/day + ops. 30–90d reserved POC — 30% discount on daily equivalent. Ops support adds $3–5k one-time. Final numbers come from pricing ops.

michelle_ae: I'll confirm whether they want a short burst or reserved and whether they want results in the dataroom. I'll escalate to pricing ops if committed term requested.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create evidence ticket #EVD-9987 and assign to dana_compliance

dana_compliance: Acknowledged. I'll prepare highlighted SOC2 excerpts and both SOW templates and upload them to the dataroom by EOD.

michelle_ae: Thanks team — will update once I have their confirmation. :thumbsup:

last_message_bot: thread archived by michelle_ae
